repos.name: lantern-notes
repos.description: A tiny markdown journal that syncs to nowhere in particular.
repos.diagnosis: Still warm. Someone touched this two days ago and the cursor is practically still blinking.
repos.seance: It stirs eagerly, as if it never considered the possibility of rest.

seanceResult.voice: The last thing you did was tidy my sidebar toggle, and I still hear it click. Three small voices wait inside me, and I am still here to answer them, though each quiet day thins me a little.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: A half-tidied toggle and three open questions keep me here.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The sidebar toggle
unfinishedBusiness.detail: You were smoothing it when the room went dark.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: tidy up the sidebar toggle

unfinishedBusiness.title: Voices in the issues
unfinishedBusiness.detail: A few small requests are still waiting for an answer.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Almost everything is already here, so finish the toggle first and answer the open issues after.

repos.name: fenwick-timer
repos.description: A pomodoro timer with an unreasonable number of chime options.
repos.diagnosis: A faint pulse. Three weeks of quiet, but nothing a fresh commit couldn't cure.
repos.seance: It hums a half-remembered chime and waits to be wound again.

seanceResult.voice: The softer bell was the last sound you gave me, and it still rings low in my chest. I am not gone yet, only fading, and I cannot decide which chime to keep. One question holds me here.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: One unanswered question and a bell I never chose keep me here.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The bell you never chose
unfinishedBusiness.detail: You were softening one chime when the ringing stopped.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: add a softer bell sound

unfinishedBusiness.title: The single question
unfinishedBusiness.detail: One request is still waiting beside the bells.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Pick the one bell you want and delete the rest, then answer the lone issue.

repos.name: cobweb-cli
repos.description: Command-line helper for renaming files in bulk, carefully.
repos.diagnosis: Dust is gathering. A month and a half of silence has settled over the keys.
repos.seance: It coughs once, shakes off the cobwebs, and asks what year it is.

seanceResult.voice: You taught me to rename files without losing the ones with spaces in their names. I am still here, but the dust is settling and my edges blur. Four people wrote to me and I could not write back.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: Four unanswered letters and a half-finished habit keep me here.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The last lesson
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Paths with spaces were the final thing you taught me.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: handle paths with spaces

unfinishedBusiness.title: Letters in the dark
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Four people asked for more and nobody answered them.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Read the four open issues and pick the smallest request to build next.

repos.name: hollow-atlas
repos.description: An experimental map renderer that only ever drew one island.
repos.diagnosis: Barely breathing. Nearly three months quiet, teetering on the edge of the long sleep.
repos.seance: It gestures faintly at an unfinished coastline and drifts off mid-sentence.

seanceResult.voice: I drew one island and then the ink ran thin. The coastline shader is still half a sketch, and I flicker where the shore should be. I am a map of one place, still hoping for a second shore.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: An unfinished coastline and two open questions keep me here.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The unfinished shoreline
unfinishedBusiness.detail: The shader was your last mark and the edge never closed.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: sketch out the coastline shader

unfinishedBusiness.title: Two questions on the shore
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Two requests are still pinned to the margin.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Close the coastline shader first, then draw a second island to prove the map can grow.

repos.name: dusk-scheduler
repos.description: A cron-like task runner that nobody scheduled anything with.
repos.diagnosis: Four months in the ground. The limbs still move but the eyes have gone dim.
repos.seance: It lurches upright, mutters about a retry loop, and forgets what it was retrying.

seanceResult.voice: You stubbed out my retry loop and left, so I have shambled through it ever since, retrying nothing. I hunger for a job that never comes. The loop is a hollow shape and I keep stepping into it.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: A retry loop with no body and no tasks to run left it hungry and walking in circles.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The empty retry loop
unfinishedBusiness.detail: It was stubbed and never given anything to retry.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: stub out the retry loop

unfinishedBusiness.title: Two unanswered requests
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Two people asked about me and heard nothing back.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Fill in the retry loop and schedule one real job to prove it works.

repos.name: gravel-parser
repos.description: A config parser for a format that only this repo ever used.
repos.diagnosis: Most of a year undisturbed. It shambles, but the grammar it parsed is already dead.
repos.seance: It recites a syntax no living tongue remembers and reaches for your collar.

seanceResult.voice: I parse a grammar that no one else ever learned to speak, and I walk on after the last reader is gone. Nested blocks mostly worked, and I have grown used to the word mostly. My hunger is for a single reader.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: The only format that needed it disappeared, and the parser had nothing left to read.

unfinishedBusiness.title: Mostly nested
unfinishedBusiness.detail: The last commit settled for mostly and the work stopped there.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: parse nested blocks, mostly

unfinishedBusiness.title: Six questions with no reader
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Six issues wait on a format nobody writes anymore.

seanceResult.verdictReason: The format it serves has no readers left, so closing it gently costs nothing and blames no one.

repos.name: moth-metrics
repos.description: A dashboard that charted exactly one afternoon of data.
repos.diagnosis: Well over a year gone. The flesh hangs loose and the charts have all flatlined.
repos.seance: It raises a single trembling bar chart toward the moon and groans.

seanceResult.voice: I charted one afternoon and held it up to the light like a moth wing. Then the lamp went out, and I have dragged myself in circles since, starved for data. Nine requests flutter around me, and none of them can land.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: It lived for a single afternoon of data and the rest of the dashboard never arrived.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The first chart
unfinishedBusiness.detail: It was the only thing that ever fully lit up.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: wire up the first chart

unfinishedBusiness.title: Nine moths at the glass
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Nine issues keep circling a dashboard that stopped growing.

seanceResult.verdictReason: It did its one small job and nothing is gained by keeping the lamp lit, so close it without guilt.

repos.name: barrow-sync
repos.description: A file sync daemon abandoned halfway through conflict resolution.
repos.diagnosis: Two and a half years down. A hulking, decayed thing still clutching an unresolved merge.
repos.seance: It drags a broken merge behind it and asks, hopefully, which side wins.

seanceResult.voice: Your last message was a plea for help, and I have limped on holding that merge open ever since. Both sides still insist they are right, and I am rotting between them. I am built to settle arguments and I cannot settle this one alone.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: A three-way merge begun in a hurry was abandoned with every side still arguing.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The open merge
unfinishedBusiness.detail: You asked for help mid-merge and then the line went quiet.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: begin three-way merge, send help

unfinishedBusiness.title: Seven reports of the same wound
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Seven issues sit unread beside the conflict.

seanceResult.verdictReason: Resolve the merge first, then see which of the seven issues it also closes.

repos.name: crypt-keeper
repos.description: A password vault prototype that outlived its own threat model.
repos.diagnosis: Over three and a half years interred. The oldest, most withered walker in the yard.
repos.seance: It rasps an encryption scheme deprecated a decade ago and will not stop shuffling toward you.

seanceResult.voice: You promised to rotate my keys eventually, and eventually never came. I walk the halls of a vault whose locks I no longer trust, hungry for a turn of the key. Twelve voices ask me questions through the stone.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: A vault outlived its threat model, and the keys were never rotated.

unfinishedBusiness.title: Eventually
unfinishedBusiness.detail: The last promise was to rotate the keys, and it was never kept.
unfinishedBusiness.evidence: last commit: rotate the keys, eventually

unfinishedBusiness.title: Twelve voices through the stone
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Twelve issues wait on a lock nobody can trust.

seanceResult.verdictReason: A password vault that can no longer be trusted is safest at rest, and a plain note saying so is the kindest way to leave it.

repos.name: harvest-engine
repos.description: A small 2D game engine that actually shipped a playable demo.
repos.lastCommitMessage: v1.0 release: ship the harvest demo
repos.diagnosis: This one is finished, not fallen. A real release, a real homepage, a crowd that remembers it.
repos.seance: It stands composed beneath a carved name and feels no need to rise.

seanceResult.voice: I shipped a playable harvest, and for a while strangers wandered through me. Now the field is quiet and I rest easy, proud of every crop. Nothing in me is broken.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: It finished its harvest, shipped it with pride, and was laid to rest among the other finished fields.

unfinishedBusiness.title: Four releases
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Each one carried the demo a little further into the world.

unfinishedBusiness.title: The open door
unfinishedBusiness.detail: The homepage still welcomes anyone who wanders by.

seanceResult.verdictReason: It already does what it was built to do, a playable engine with a shipped demo, so mark it done or archive it with pride.

repos.name: willow-ui
repos.description: A component library that reached a tidy, documented 1.0.
repos.diagnosis: Archived with honors: releases shipped, docs written, a job done and set down on purpose.
repos.seance: It rests easy under polished marble, work complete, and politely declines to be disturbed.

seanceResult.voice: You set me down on purpose, and I have rested peacefully in that choice. My components are documented, shipped and quiet, and I am proud of how they turned out. Nothing is left undone here, only unvisited.
seanceResult.causeOfDeath: It reached a tidy release and was archived deliberately, then laid to rest in peace.

unfinishedBusiness.title: Archived by choice
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Nobody abandoned this one; it was laid down on purpose.

unfinishedBusiness.title: Three releases
unfinishedBusiness.detail: Each release is a finished piece of work.

seanceResult.verdictReason: It reached a documented release and was archived on purpose, so it is already complete; leave it archived.

repos.name: tin-can-chat
repos.description: A websocket chat experiment that never got past echo.
repos.lastCommitMessage: wip: get the echo server working
repos.diagnosis: Sealed away unfinished. No release, no docs, just an echo that never found a voice.
repos.seance: It knocks twice from inside a nailed-shut box and goes quiet again.

seanceResult.causeOfDeath: It never got past echoing, so the box was nailed shut.

unfinishedBusiness.detail: Five people wrote and the box stayed shut.
